property.name: Greens Storage Georgetown
property.opened: Operated by CubeSmart (store 6093); the signage reads CubeSmart

buildings.name: Main Building
buildings.note: Three-story climate-controlled building A, 362 ft long (375 ft with the office at the northeast corner) by about 116 ft (permit set). Office, break room and customer entrance at the northeast corner; lobby, restrooms and elevator on the north side. Level 1: 1001-1157 inside on 5 ft hallways, 1500-1538 drive-up units with outside doors on the west wall (1500-1504) and the south wall (1505-1538). Levels 2 and 3: 2000-2374 and 3000-3338. Unit positions are from the Addendum 3/4 floor plans; the unit numbers follow the plans' size sequence (no numbered plan on file).

buildings.name: Building B (North Drive-Up Row)
buildings.note: Building B: one-story row of 36 10x20 drive-up bays, 362 ft 8 in by 21 ft 8 in, doors facing building A (permit set A2.06). 4000-4035, numbered east to west. Which row carries 4000 vs 6000 and the numbering direction are not on any plan: they follow the architect's B-C-D lettering and the counterclockwise order of the 1500 drive-ups - confirm on site.

buildings.name: Building D (South Drive-Up Row)
buildings.note: Building D: one-story row of 36 10x20 drive-up bays, 362 ft 8 in by 21 ft 8 in, doors facing building A (permit set A2.06). 6000-6034, numbered west to east; the east-end bay has no number on the rent roll. Which row carries 4000 vs 6000 and the numbering direction are not on any plan: they follow the architect's B-C-D lettering and the counterclockwise order of the 1500 drive-ups - confirm on site.

buildings.name: Building C (West Drive-Up Row)
buildings.note: Building C: one-story row of 15 10x20 drive-up bays, 152 ft 8 in by 21 ft 8 in, doors facing east toward building A (permit set A2.06). 5000-5014, numbered north to south. Which row carries 4000 vs 6000 and the numbering direction are not on any plan: they follow the architect's B-C-D lettering and the counterclockwise order of the 1500 drive-ups - confirm on site.
